Adolion: Night Courts
Author view
Overview
Memory
⚑
Where you are
The Dead in the Mist
The scene is tense.
About this story
You lead a C-rank party of the Aegis City Adventurers Guild, with Belle and Dalan at your side, and tonight's posting comes from the almoners of the Grand Temple: people are vanishing from the slums between midnight and dawn, and the watch will not go down there after dark. Expect gothic horror, long nights and strange company on the road. Bring your persona as the party's leader, a Guild adventurer who takes the jobs nobody else will.
Recently
You left The Accused behind and moved into The Dead in the Mist.
Max Nightriver led Selena away from Glasnoa into the depths of Thornwood, seeking shelter from the coming Inquisition. They found the cabin of Kayla Thornwood, who revealed she had been expecting them and warned that the Inquisition would ride by first light. Inside, as Selena questioned whether Kayla truly took souls, the witch spoke of whispers and changing the writing of stories.
Open threads
What price Kayla will demand for the lake's secrets, and what Max will pay.
What the noble's shadow moving against the Inquisition means, and whether Max is that noble.
Whether the Inquisition will reach Kayla's cabin before dawn, now that Kayla says they will ride by first light.
The story so far
Ren Calwisk, Inquisitor of Boher, brought the party to the Aegis slums after a Grand Temple notice concerning nine disappearances since the first frost, where paintings signed "Butcher" hung in a shop window. Ren declared Selena Forestsong would burn at first light in Glasnoa, presenting a worn leather grimoire he claimed to have found beneath her floorboards. Selena denied ever seeing the book; Max Nightriver insisted it was planted. Erevan and Reeve Tull each stated they had not been present when it was hidden.
